limitations: LOCAL PHOTO REVIEW by development agent, NOT a paid/provider model response.
Reference photographs show 1979/1982 Mk1 bodies; exact 1976 trim unconfirmed.
Near-side photo has perspective and low camera elevation; all intervals are broad estimates.
Native wheel sizing may conflict with physical wheelbase/observed axle positions; retain discrepancies.
Round lamps, hatch seals and hidden mounting require native-part fit; no physical assembly evidence.
